# U124: The leader on Home: Amara’s Watching spans thirteen teams, so it is a table of teams, worst first, with no person’s name in it; a team’s “{k} need attention” opens Goals whose count line says k; “Changed since Friday 6 Nov” counts open lists of that length, and the table’s last column is “Since Fri 6 Nov”; on Wed 11 Nov one cell says how many of them are checked in for week 46, and opens the rest

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `HOME-MANAGER`, `HOME-LEADER`, `HABIT-MEASURE`
- **Budget:** at most 3 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U124

## Steps and checks

- _Note:_ Home rule 4 (HM3): three or more teams are drawn as teams, ordered as Goals orders "By team" (worstGroupsFirst).
- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Check:** The “Goals you watch” part (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`) shows.
- **Check:** The teams table (`.teams-table`) in the “Goals you watch” part (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/· \d+ goals in \d+ teams/.test(head)`, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Goals you watch"]')`; `const head = (await block.locator('h2').innerText()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ')`. Else it says: Watching’s heading is “{head}”.
- _Note:_ Worst first: the most off track, then at risk, then no recent update, then no check-in yet; five teams, then the rest.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `tally.length === 5 && ordered && await block.locator('a.teams-more').count() === 1`, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Goals you watch"]')`; `const table = block.locator('.teams-table')`; `const tally = await table.locator('tbody tr').evaluateAll((trs) => trs.map((tr) => { const n = (w) => Number(((tr.querySelector('.teams-counts')?.textContent || '').match(new RegExp('(\\d+) ' + w)) || [])[1] || 0); return [n('off track'), n('at risk'), n('no recent update'), n('no check-in yet')]; }))`; `const ordered = tally.every((t, i) => i === 0 || (() => { const a = tally[i - 1]; for (let x = 0; x < 4; x++) if (a[x] !== t[x]) return a[x] > t[x]; return true; })())`. Else it says: the teams are not five, worst first: {JSON.stringify(tally)}.
- _Note:_ No person's name is in the table: teams and goals are ranked, never people.
- **Check:** It fails if the teams table names {named.join(', ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “home”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ A team's "{k} need attention" opens Goals for that team with the switch on, and its count line says k.
- **Step.** Press the link in the teams needs (`.teams-needs a`) in the teams table (`.teams-table`) in the “Goals you watch” part (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “scope=watching&team=…&attention=1”.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `` new RegExp(`^${k} needs? attention`).test(line) ``, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Goals you watch"]')`; `const table = block.locator('.teams-table')`; `const link = table.locator('.teams-needs a').first()`; `const k = Number(((await link.innerText()).match(/^(\d+)/) || [])[1])`; `const line = await p.locator('.goals-line').first().innerText()`. Else it says: a team’s “{k} need attention” opened Goals saying “{line}”.
- _Note:_ Changed since (rule 5, HM4). Monday's first look counted from that Monday, and nothing had moved: the part is absent. Home last opened on Fri 6 Nov (the `home-seen` pref, per browser), on Wed 11 Nov it says what moved since, each count opening Goals with a count line of that length and the filter line in its words; the teams table's last column too.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Monday 9 November 2026.
- **Check:** The “Goals you watch” part (`[data-part="Goals you watch"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if “Changed since” shows on Monday though nothing moved since Monday.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `([k, v]) => localStorage.setItem(k, v)`, where `const block = p.locator('[data-part="Goals you watch"]')`; `const table = block.locator('.teams-table')`; `const link = table.locator('.teams-needs a').first()`; `const k = Number(((await link.innerText()).match(/^(\d+)/) || [])[1])`, given `['faro-prefs:platform-org:amara:home-seen', JSON.stringify({ last: '2026-11-06', prev: null })]`.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The “Changed since” part (`[data-part="Changed since"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if “Changed since” says “{title}”, counts {moved.map((m) => m.text).join(', ')}, with {rows} rows.
- **Check:** It fails if a “Changed since” row has no status shape beside its word.
- For each of `moved`:
  - **Step.** Press a part of the page in the “Changed since” part (`[data-part="Changed since"]`).
  - **Check:** The address becomes {worked out in the journey as `new RegExp('scope=watching&moved=${m.kind}&since=2026-11-06')`}.
  - **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
  - **Check:** It fails if “{m.text}” opened Goals saying “{said}”.
  - **Check:** It fails if “{m.text}” opened Goals whose filter line says “{words}”.
  - Press the browser’s Back.
  - **Check:** The “Changed since” part (`[data-part="Changed since"]`) shows.
- **Check:** It fails if the teams table’s last column is “{since}”, not “Since Fri 6 Nov”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “changed”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ How the week's check-ins stand (HM7): on Wed 11 Nov, one cell over the set drawn as teams, never a name; it opens the goals with no check-in for the week yet, and Goals counts exactly those.
- Go to `/` in the demo on Wednesday 11 November 2026.
- **Check:** The dash standing (`.dash-standing`) shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `!!a && !named2.length`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const cell = p.locator('.dash-standing')`; `const said = (await cell.innerText().catch(() => '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`; `const [, a, b] = said.match(/Checked in for week 46 (\d+) of (\d+) goals?/) || []`; `const named2 = s0.people.map((x) => x.name).filter((n) => said.includes(n))`. Else it says: the standing cell reads “{said}”{worked out in the journey as `named2.length ? ', naming ${named2.join(', ')}' : ''`}.
- _Note:_ Beside it (HB3), the same goals' measure: before the due day, “So far: {u} of {n} goals”; no name. (A cell's under-line, “Due by …” and By week, is left out on a phone.)
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/without being asked So far: \d+ of \d+ goals/.test(habitSaid) && !s0.people.some((x) => habitSaid.includes(x.name))`, where `const s0 = await h.snapshot()`; `const habitSaid = (await p.locator('.dash-habit').innerText().catch(() => '')).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()`. Else it says: the habit cell reads “{habitSaid}”.
